8.24. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.area¶

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to areas.

Classes

AreaAfterArea([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(area_1, area_2)’ if area_2 is after area_1 in the positive direction.
AreaAtArea([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(area_1, area_2)’ if area_2 is before or after area_1.
AreaAtSignal([after, argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(signal, area)’ if area of type AREA_TYPE is before or after signal of type SIGNAL_TYPE.
AreaInArea([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(area_1, area_2)’ if area_1 is inside of area_2.
AreaIntersectsArea([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(area_1, area_2)’ if area_1 and area_2, both of type AREA_TYPE intersected with each other.
ObjectInArea([positiveSide, argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(obj, area)’ if obj of type INSIDE_TYPE_C is inside of area of type AREA_TYPE.
